children: U.S. footwear retailer's Q2 sales declined and missed analyst expectations
Company lowered full-year guidance due to ongoing promotional market and misaligned assortments
Company lowers fiscal 2026 net sales outlook to $1.100 bln-$1.111 bln, down 2-3% vs 2025
Shoe Station Group cuts fiscal 2026 GAAP EPS forecast to $0.32-$0.47, Adjusted EPS to $0.75-$0.90
Company expects promotional environment to persist through rest of year
PROMOTIONAL PRESSURE - Co said increasingly promotional footwear market and competitive pricing pressured sales and gross margin
ASSORTMENT MISALIGNMENT - Co said sales were hurt by merchandise assortments not fully aligned with customer preferences
INVENTORY LIQUIDATION - Co said liquidation of aged and excess inventory contributed to lower gross profit margin
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 1 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the apparel & accessories retailers peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Shoe Station Group Inc is $19.00, about 46.9% above its September 9 closing price of $12.93
The stock recently traded at 8 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 11 three months ago
